standard.summary: 训练前自动检查配置合理性、数据集质量、运行时依赖，生成预检报告。提前发现潜在问题，避免训练中途失败。
standard.effect: 检查项包括：学习率范围是否合理、数据集图片数量和格式、缓存是否完整、显存是否够用、优化器兼容性等。报告写入 training_advisor_report.json。
standard.whenToUse: 始终推荐开启（默认就是开启的）。开销极小（训练前一次性检查）。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要关闭。如果你对配置非常有把握且想跳过预检节省几秒钟。

standard_en.summary: Automatically checks configuration sanity, dataset quality and runtime dependencies before training, and produces a preflight report. It finds potential problems early and avoids a failure part-way through.
standard_en.effect: The checks include whether the learning rate is in a sensible range, the dataset's image count and formats, whether the cache is complete, whether VRAM is sufficient, optimizer compatibility and so on. The report is written to training_advisor_report.json.
standard_en.whenToUse: Always recommended (and on by default). The overhead is tiny (a one-off check before training).
standard_en.avoidWhen: No need to turn it off. Only if you are very sure of your configuration and want to skip preflight to save a few seconds.

advanced.principle: Advisor 读配置做静态评估，不加载模型：(1) 显存估算与舒适区间；(2) 爆显存防护（safeguard）参数；(3) LR finder 设置；(4) 数据集路径与规模；(5) 文本编码器与 compile token shape；(6) A/B 两层可选特性的兼容性。每条产出带 severity 的 finding。
advanced.intervention: WebUI 点“训练预检”时由 /api/train/preflight 现算并回传（payload.training_advisor）；训练启动后训练器再把同一份报告写到 output_dir/training_advisor_report.json。预检里只有“数据集缺失”会阻断启动，显存与特性类估算一律降级成警告，避免估价误拦训练。
advanced.expectedImpact: 防止常见配置错误导致的训练失败。不直接影响训练质量。
advanced.tradeoffs: training_advisor_log_summary 在日志中输出简要报告。

advanced_en.principle: The Advisor evaluates the config statically without loading a model: (1) VRAM estimate and comfort band; (2) out-of-memory safeguard settings; (3) LR finder settings; (4) dataset path and size; (5) text encoder and compile token shape; (6) compatibility of the optional A/B feature tiers. Every item is a finding with a severity.
advanced_en.intervention: The WebUI's "training preflight" button calls /api/train/preflight, which computes the report and returns it as payload.training_advisor; once training starts the trainer writes the same report to output_dir/training_advisor_report.json. Only "dataset missing" blocks the start -- VRAM and feature estimates are downgraded to warnings so an estimate can never refuse a run.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Prevents training failures from common config mistakes. Does not directly affect training quality.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: training_advisor_log_summary outputs a brief report to the logs.
